headline: Heavy Fire at Cape and Mooring; Linn Mercy Rejoins the Fray
war_summary: The guns at Callum's Cape have not slackened since the last edition; fresh actions were logged there as this sheet went to press and forty-four across the day, the heaviest tally on the map, with the Warden flag over four works and the Colonial over three. Mooring County presses close behind — five actions in the past two hours and thirty-one in the day, its ledger showing near sixteen thousand seven hundred Colonial and sixteen thousand Warden dead, the Wardens holding ten works to two. Linn Mercy, quiet at the earlier report, has woken sharply: four actions in two hours, thirty-one in the day, casualties rising on both sides, the lines standing seven Colonial, three Warden and one unclaimed. Weathered Expanse burns hottest of the northern fronts with seven actions this watch, its count now six Warden, one Colonial and two unclaimed. Stonecradle, lately flared, has fallen silent these two hours, as have Nevish Line and Godcrofts. Marban Hollow also rests this watch, its lines unchanged at five Colonial, two Warden and one unclaimed.
